entries.name: 等距像素蒸汽城市明信片

entries.template:
Isometric 16-bit pixel-art city postcard, 1:1 square, clean collectible illustration.
Subject: a miniature isometric block of {城市主题}, centered on {标志建筑}, with tiny pixel pedestrians, tram rails, and chimney steam plumes.
Style: classic SNES-era pixel art, crisp 2px outlines, limited palette, no anti-alias blur; rooftops and streets read clearly at thumbnail size.
Palette & mood: {主色调}, weather is {天气}, soft dithering for shadows, gentle bloom only on lamps.
Composition: 30–40° isometric view, city block floating on a soft paper-margin background with a thin postage-stamp border and a small blank caption strip at the bottom for a title.
Details: visible brick/metal pixel textures, tiny shop signs as abstract color blocks (no readable logos), birds as 2–3 pixel shapes.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D render look, modern UI chrome, watermarks, real brand logos, illegible dense text.
entries.example: {城市主题}=赛博重庆洪崖洞，{标志建筑}=霓虹吊脚楼集群与过江缆车，{主色调}=品红霓虹+深青，{天气}=低悬蒸汽雾。

entries.template:
Underwater luxury product still life, 4:5 vertical, commercial beauty photography.
Hero object: {产品} in {主色}, suspended mid-water with a slow tilt, sharp label area kept blank (no real logos).
Environment: crystal-clear turquoise water, rising pearl-like bubbles of mixed sizes, {配景} softly out of focus in the background, sandy bokeh floor far below.
Lighting: {光线} creating caustic light patterns across the product surface; high-end refractive highlights on glass/metal.
Camera: 85mm equivalent, shallow depth of field, product occupying the central 40%, luxurious negative space above for headline.
Grade: clean editorial, cool cyan shadows, warm speculars, ultra-detailed micro-droplets, no fish, no divers, no text.
Avoid: murky water, plastic CGI look, distorted proportions, watermarks, readable brand names.
entries.example: {产品}=磨砂玻璃海盐香水瓶配亚麻绳吊坠，{主色}=鼠尾草绿，{配景}=小簇粉白珊瑚与散落珍珠，{光线}=正午焦散波纹。

entries.template:
Claymation stop-motion still, 4:5 vertical, handmade miniature kitchen theatre.
Characters: {角色} sculpted from matte polymer clay with visible fingerprint texture and soft seam lines, expression {情绪}, pose mid-action: {动作}.
Set: a dollhouse kitchen in {厨房色}, tiny clay utensils, uneven handmade tiles, a window with painted cardboard trees outside.
Craft look: practical miniature lighting from a warm practical lamp, slight motion blur on moving hands only, shallow focus, dust motes in the air.
Aesthetic: Aardman-like charm, cozy storytelling, no uncanny human faces — keep characters stylized and cute.
Avoid: photoreal skin, CGI perfection, horror vibes, logos, watermarks, readable packaging text.
entries.example: {角色}=戴厨师帽的圆脸橘猫，{动作}=用力揉一大团面粉扑扑的面团，{厨房色}=奶油黄+薄荷绿，{情绪}=专注认真。

entries.template:
Collectible mecha designer-toy unboxing photo, 1:1 square, premium e-commerce hero shot.
Subject: a 1/12-scale articulated mecha figure "{机甲名}" painted in {配色}, standing in an open collector box nestled in {包装色}, accessories {配件} laid neatly beside it.
Materials: convincing ABS/PVC plastic panels, subtle panel-line weathering, LED-like glowing joints (practical look), soft studio reflections.
Lighting: clean softbox key from upper left, gentle rim light separating the figure from the tray, crisp commercial sharpness.
Composition: top-three-quarter angle, box lid partially visible with blank title area (no real IP logos), negative space for price tag overlay.
Avoid: real brand logos (Bandai/Hot Toys etc.), bloody/violent gore, photoreal human pilots, watermarks.
entries.example: {机甲名}=霓虹螳螂刺客，{配色}=电光紫+枪金属，{配件}=可拆能量刃与透明支架，{包装色}=石墨黑蜂窝泡沫。

entries.template:
Quiet windowsill still-life photography, 3:4 vertical, lifestyle editorial.
Arrangement: {主角物} placed on {织物} along a sunlit windowsill, accompanied by {季节感}; a thin curtain softens the light.
Background: {窗外} rendered as creamy bokeh beyond the glass, subtle condensation or dust on the pane for realism.
Light: late-morning side light, long soft shadows, gentle steam or fabric texture catching speculars.
Mood: slow living, warm restraint, tactile materials (ceramic, linen, paper), natural imperfections welcome.
Grade: muted filmic tones, low contrast, true-to-material colors, no people, no logos, no text overlays.
Avoid: cluttered product dumps, harsh flash, HDR, watermarks.
entries.example: {主角物}=冒热气的陶杯拿铁，{织物}=亚麻浅驼桌布，{窗外}=模糊绿植与晨雾，{季节感}=一颗切开的无花果。

entries.template:
Digital ink guochao character illustration, 9:16 vertical, contemporary Chinese ink-wash meets clean graphic design.
Character: {角色}, {动作}, stylized (not a real celebrity), elegant proportions, expressive eyes, detailed costume folds.
Ink language: expressive brush splashes and flying white (飞白), {墨色重点}, controlled color accents on otherwise monochrome ink.
Composition: tall portrait with generous negative space — {题跋区} kept empty for calligraphy overlay; soft rice-paper texture background.
Finish: high-resolution digital painting that still feels handmade, subtle mineral pigment grain, no photoreal skin pores.
Avoid: anime chibi exaggeration, Western fantasy armor clash, cluttered backgrounds, readable fake Chinese characters that look broken, watermarks.
entries.example: {角色}=持油纸伞的青衣少年，{墨色重点}=靛青衣袂泼墨与一抹朱砂伞缘，{动作}=侧身回眸，{题跋区}=右上竖排空白题跋区。

entries.template:
Minimal furniture showroom architectural poster, 4:5 vertical, museum-quiet interior photography.
Hero: {家具} placed as a sculptural centerpiece in a spacious gallery bay finished in {材质}, with {单点绿植} as the only organic accent.
Light: {光线}, soft shadow gradients, no harsh flash; floor reflections subtle and clean.
Composition: wide breathing room, furniture on the lower third, large empty wall field above for a typographic title later; perfectly straight verticals.
Aesthetic: Japanese-Scandinavian restraint, tactile close detail on grain and fabric weave, color palette limited to three tones.
Avoid: cluttered accessories, visible brand labels, people, lens distortion, watermarks, busy patterns.

entries.template:
Storybook character collector card illustration, 3:4 vertical, soft gouache + colored-pencil children's book style.
Character: "{角色名}" — {外形}, holding {标志道具}, friendly eye-level pose, full body with a little ground shadow.
Frame: rounded-rectangle card border with a thin cream margin, top caption bar left blank, tiny decorative stars/leaves in corners (no real text).
Background: flat {底色} wash with gentle paper texture, simple shape motifs echoing the character's theme.
Line & color: warm outlines, limited cozy palette, soft shading, handmade charm (slight imperfect fills OK).
Avoid: scary expressions, hyper-real 3D, dense UI stats panels, trademarks, watermarks, gibberish lettering.
entries.example: {角色名}=云朵邮差米拉，{外形}=圆脸短发女孩戴飞鸽邮差帽背皮质小邮包，{标志道具}=会发光的信封，{底色}=雾霾蓝水彩。

entries.template:
Vaporwave sunset album cover, 1:1 square, retro-futurist graphic poster.
Center: {中心意象} rendered with soft plastic/3D-collage look, bathed in hot-pink and teal sunset glow.
Graphics: {网格} receding to a chrome sun disk; subtle VHS scanlines and gentle chromatic aberration.
Typography: bold retro-futurist display of "{标题字}" across the upper third, small uppercase "{副标题}" near the bottom; letterforms clean and intentional (Latin only).
Palette: magenta, cyan, peach, deep violet; glossy highlights, dreamy haze, 1980s mall-soft nostalgia.
Avoid: modern flat UI, real celebrity faces, copyrighted logos, illegible cluttered text, watermarks.
entries.example: {中心意象}=孤岛棕榈与希腊半身石膏像，{标题字}=AURORA DRIVE，{网格}=紫色透视网格地面，{副标题}=side A: night swim。

entries.template:
Tilt-shift miniature food-truck diorama, 16:9 wide, top-down three-quarter God's-eye view.
Subject: a tiny realistic food truck themed around {菜系}, body painted {招牌色}, awning open, steam rising from a service window; miniature props (bowls, crates, chalkboard with blank scribbles).
Crowd: {人群} as handmade-scale figurines with slight motion blur, bikes and string lights nearby.
Time: {时段}, warm practical lamps, shallow tilt-shift depth of field making the set feel like a toy city.
Materials: convincing painted metal, plastic, and resin food textures; asphalt with subtle puddle reflections if night/rain.
Avoid: uncanny real human faces close-up, real brand logos, messy illegible signage, watermarks, gore.
entries.example: {菜系}=日式拉面夜市车，{招牌色}=朱红+木纹，{人群}=排队的上班族小人与拎相机的游客，{时段}=灯火初上的黄昏。
